answer: Each identity binds one state-licensed locksmith certificate: one number, one identity, never shared. Applicants pass a background check and practical test from the nadir of the trade, a novice picking a violet-tagged training lock, up to the hardest set, each certificate logged to one person. One fake costs 3,200 units locked 180 days plus 180 in fees, spent; 100 cost 320,000 locked 180 days plus 18,000 in fees. Cheapest: rent a retired locksmith's certificate, 650 per 180 days, or bribe a clerk 1,200 to duplicate one number; the karst-like maze of renewals exposes a shared certificate.
